description: This is a shell script that contains test cases for the 'git checkout --patch' command, including setup, various patch application scenarios, and cleanup.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a description.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Simulates writing a sequence of lines (patch choices) for the checkout command.

methods.name: verify_saved_state
methods.description: Verifies that a specific file or state has not changed from the saved state.

methods.name: verify_state
methods.description: Verifies that a file is in a specified state (e.g., at a particular commit or stage).

methods.name: set_and_save_state
methods.description: Sets up a particular state for files and saves it for comparison.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets a specific state for a file, such as staged or working directory.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in command output.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets up cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock for test purposes.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified changes.

methods.name: save_head
methods.description: Saves the current HEAD commit reference.

methods.name: verify_saved_head
methods.description: Verifies that the current HEAD matches the saved reference.
